description_en: Updates the name and description of a workspace
description_zh: 更新工作空间名称和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace update-workspace --workspace-id 123 --display-name workspace-example --description This_is_an_example_workspace. --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWorkspace

parameters.description_en: The ID of the workspace. For more information, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
parameters.description_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description_en:
The display name of the workspace. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 3 to 23 characters in length and can contain letters, underscores (\_), and digits.

- The name must start with a letter.

- The name must be unique within the current region.
parameters.description_zh:
工作空间显示名称，格式如下。
- 长度为3~23 个字符，可以包含字母、下划线或数字。
- 必须以大小字母开头。
- 当前地域内唯一。
